# Your Energy Best (Lumaria Energy)

> San Diego solar and home battery company, run by David West. Two things: new solar and batteries with $0 down options, and help for homeowners who already have solar (audits, troubleshooting, repair guidance, adding a battery). Solar and batteries only. We do not offer HVAC, heating or air conditioning services.

Serves San Diego County and Orange County, California. Phone (858) 786-2204 (858-SUN-2204). The customer app for solar owners is lumaria (www.lumaria.energy).

## New solar and batteries
- [Free solar and battery quote](https://yourenergybest.com/quote/): $0 down options for eligible homes (PPA, prepaid lease, CEA Solar Plus with no credit check in CEA cities), plus loan and cash, compared side by side with escalators and dealer fees shown.
- [Compare options](https://yourenergybest.com/options/): how PPA, prepaid, loan, cash and $0 down programs work in 2026, after the homeowner tax credit ended.
- [Home batteries](https://yourenergybest.com/home-battery/): Tesla Powerwall 3, Enphase IQ Battery, FranklinWH; adding a battery to existing solar; SDCP battery rebate ($2,000–$6,000 per battery) and CEA programs.
- [Solar quotes](https://yourenergybest.com/solar-quote/)

## Already have solar
- [Solar not working / troubleshooting](https://yourenergybest.com/solar-repair/): not producing, monitoring offline, inverter errors, bill went up, installer out of business; what's under warranty and how to get it fixed.
- [Solar savings audit](https://yourenergybest.com/audit/): production versus what was promised, bills and true-up, rate plan and agreement, from someone who didn't sell the system. See current price on the page.
- [Independent solar inspection](https://yourenergybest.com/solar-inspection/): on-site roof, mounting, wiring, panel, inverter and battery check with a written report.
- [lumaria app](https://www.lumaria.energy/): free for solar owners; shows what a system is really producing and saving.

## Learn
- [Knowledge Center](https://yourenergybest.com/knowledge/): plain answers on net billing (NEM 3.0), time-of-use rates, batteries, PPAs vs prepaid vs cash, dealer fees, escalators, true-up bills and monitoring apps.
